result.brief: 揭示多模态潜空间视觉推理中的“心理模拟崩塌”失效模式，并提出 AnchorSim 对比蒸馏使生成的视觉潜变量真正影响预测。
result.reason: Diagnoses latent visual reasoning collapse in MLLMs and proposes contrastive distillation making continuous visual latents causally consequential; contributes to latent multimodal representation and unified reasoning.
